+"""Script to automate release preparation."""
+
+import re
+import sys
+from datetime import date
+
+RELEASE_NOTES_FILE = "docs/en/docs/release-notes.md"
+RELEASE_HEADER_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^## (\d+\.\d+\.\d+)\s*(\(.*\))?\s*$")
+
+def main() -> None:
+    with open(RELEASE_NOTES_FILE) as f:
+        lines = f.readlines()
+
+    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
+        match = RELEASE_HEADER_PATTERN.match(line)
+        if not match:
+            continue
+
+        version = match.group(1)
+        date_part = match.group(2)
+
+        if date_part:
+            print(f"Latest release {version} already has a date: {date_part}")
+            sys.exit(0)
+
+        today = date.today().isoformat()
+        lines[i] = f"## {version} ({today})\n"
+        print(f"Added date: {version} ({today})")
+
+        with open(RELEASE_NOTES_FILE, "w") as f:
+            f.writelines(lines)
+        sys.exit(0)
+
+    print("No release header found")
+    sys.exit(1)
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+class Reawaitable(Generic[T]):
+    __sentinel = object()
+
+    def __init__(self, awaitable: Awaitable[T]) -> None:
+        self.awaitable = awaitable
+        self.result = self.__sentinel
+
+    def __await__(self) -> Iterator[T]:
+        if self.result is self.__sentinel:
+            self.result = yield from self.awaitable.__await__()
